data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic words 'hashim' (sea) and 'ahat' (shore). It signifies a place where the sea meets the land. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hashimaht usually hope their child will grow to embody sea shore and live with faith, good character and purpose.
